description: Layer 1 (Basic HTML fixes): Add data-cfasync='false' to the module script tag and fix the skip-to-content link to be keyboard-focusable before React hydration. These are simple attribute additions in index.html.
steps: In apps/frontend/index.html, find the line `<script type="module" src="/src/index.jsx"></script>` and add `data-cfasync="false"` attribute to prevent Cloudflare Rocket Loader from processing the module script. This reduces render-blocking by ~150ms and TBT by ~168ms.

In apps/frontend/index.html, fix the skip-to-content link accessibility. The link has class `sr-only focus:not-sr-only` but Lighthouse flags it as not keyboard-focusable. The issue is that the `sr-only` class uses `clip: rect(0,0,0,0)` which can interfere with focus in some browsers. Add explicit `tabindex="1"` to ensure it receives keyboard focus reliably. Actually, the better fix is to ensure the skip link has proper focus styles by adding `focus:clip-auto focus:w-auto focus:h-auto focus:overflow-visible focus:whitespace-normal` to override ALL sr-only properties on focus. The current `focus:not-sr-only` class should handle this but check that Tailwind v3 generates the correct output. The inline critical CSS has `.sr-only` but no `.focus\:not-sr-only` rule. Add a `focus:not-sr-only` rule to the inline critical CSS that properly resets position, width, height, clip, overflow, margin, and padding.

Also in the skip link: remove the inline critical CSS `.sr-only` and add a complete pair that includes the focus state, so before React hydrates and Tailwind loads, the skip link is still accessible via keyboard.
acceptance_criteria: The script tag in index.html has data-cfasync='false' attribute
The skip link is keyboard-focusable: it has proper focus CSS in the inline critical styles that override sr-only on :focus
The inline critical CSS includes a .focus\:not-sr-only rule (or equivalent) that resets position/clip/width/height on focus
verification: Run: grep 'data-cfasync' apps/frontend/index.html - should show data-cfasync="false" on the module script
Run: grep -A5 'focus.*not-sr-only\|focus:not-sr-only' apps/frontend/index.html - should show focus CSS that resets sr-only
findings: Build succeeds cleanly. All 623 tests pass across 67 test files. No snapshot updates needed. The inline critical CSS now has .focus\:not-sr-only:focus rule placed directly after .sr-only.
